items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover matching fittings used to reconnect the failed indoor heating pipe. Four at €9 gross give €36.
Section 7.1.8(e) requires confirmation that the 28 mm fittings were used on the repaired run; the only pipe billed is 15 mm. If a 28 mm connection is documented, five at €18 gross give €90.
Under §7.1.8(e), the 28 mm elbow is not attributable to the documented 15 mm repair without evidence of a matching connection. If verified, one elbow is estimated at €17 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers minor fixings used in the repair without requiring each fixing to be matched individually. Eight at €0.80 gross give €6.40.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers necessary repair fixings, but §7.1.8(e) requires the clamp size to suit the repaired installation. If the clamps fit the documented assembly, four at €4 gross give €16.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover like-for-like renewal of the failed indoor heating pipe. At €14 gross per metre, 6.4 m totals €89.60.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary labour for the pipe repair, while §7.1.5 excludes time spent on unrelated jobs. Allowing about 5 of the 6.75 billed hours at €82 gross gives €410.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(g) limit the allowance to necessary assistance on the pipe repair. If that time is substantiated, allow about 4 of the 5.75 billed hours at €46 gross, or €184.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the original insulation on the repaired pipe. Six sections at €22 gross each, consistent with Case 39, give €132.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers wire consumed in securing the insulation, but §7.1.8(e) excludes stock not used on the repair. Allow €5 gross for the amount ordinarily needed, rather than the full 2 kg.

Section 7.1.7(c) permits a lump sum for minor installation consumables, but §7.1.8(c) bars duplication of separately listed materials. Allow €18 gross for additional consumables used on the pipe repair.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge per contractor per invoice. The sole charge is estimated at €65 gross, consistent with Case 39.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of the removed pipe and insulation, not waste from the unrelated flooring job. If the repair share is substantiated, allow €25 gross for the small quantity.
The hallway was not affected, so §§3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude repainting. If direct damage were established, 12 m² at €16 gross per m² would give €192.
Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude replacement in the separate, undamaged storage room. If covered, 15 m² at €55 gross per m² for removal and standard replacement would give €825.
Section 7.1.8(a) excludes routine upkeep unrelated to the heating-pipe leak. A basic service would cost about €85 gross if covered.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes administrative fees billed on top of itemised labour and materials. The nominal estimate for one fee, if payable, is €15 gross.
